scenarios.title: Regression suite preserves proof-tier separation
scenarios.prompt: Run the local regression tests for context filtering, session deduplication, malformed input, wrapper contamination, and quality metadata.

scenarios.title: Run a reproducible 60-day local usage scan from a hash-bound manifest
scenarios.prompt: Scan the available Codex sessions for the fixed UTC window and rank explicit selectors, actions, and underutilized candidates.
expected: The output records the UTC window and source coverage
L1, L2, L3, and L4 are separated
The scan completes without malformed-line errors
A transcript hash change fails closed
evidence: python3 scripts/skill_usage_audit.py --source-manifest docs/audits/skill-usage-audit-source-manifest.json --skill-manifest docs/audits/skill-usage-audit-skill-manifest.json --start 2026-06-10 --end 2026-08-10 with the recorded external labels
218936 in-window events across 33 sessions from 41 SHA-256-bound transcript files
102 SHA-256-bound canonical skill files and 111 inventory labels
931 filtered user prompts, 262 excluded context blocks, 0 malformed JSONL lines

scenarios.title: Reject false usage from malformed and out-of-window records
scenarios.prompt: Evaluate mixed session fixtures containing stale events, malformed JSONL, repeated context, and nested tool-call examples.
expected: Out-of-window selector text is not counted
Malformed lines are counted as malformed rather than usage
Nested tool names are marked L3 and not host-activation proof
evidence: Nested action output includes the warning that it is not host-activation proof

rejected_edits.edit: Mass-edit the 20 skills or all 102 canonical skill packages immediately
rejected_edits.reason: The checkout is dirty and the usage evidence does not prove host activation, outcome value, or a need for broad edits. Use bounded pilots and clean-worktree provenance first.

rejected_edits.edit: Treat plain mentions, nested wrapper strings, or plugin mentions as execution counts
rejected_edits.reason: They are L3 supporting evidence or namespace-level signals, not L1/L2 activation evidence.

notes: This evidence validates the local usage-audit workflow only. It does not promote transcript selectors to host-loader, successful-execution, outcome, or production proof.
